query: MATCH (c:Company {companyName:'Huawei'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c) WITH c,count(DISTINCT t) AS totalTdocs OPTIONAL MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t2:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c) WITH totalTdocs,count(DISTINCT t2) AS resolvedTdocs RETURN totalTdocs,resolvedTdocs,CASE WHEN totalTdocs=0 THEN null ELSE round(100.0*resolvedTdocs/totalTdocs,1) END AS ratio
